Two Bikes Bike Party

Knoxville, TN · Old City · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Two Bikes Bike Party is a social group ride in Knoxville, TN. It rolls last Friday of the month at 6:00 pm from Two Bikes. About 4–8 miles, 8–10 mph, party pace. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8–10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Two Bikes Bike Party group ride

Themed monthly social ride from Knoxville's nonprofit bike shop. Four to eight miles at party pace, usually ending at a brewery or some other destination rather than back at the shop. Helmets required, locks recommended.
